summary: [standards] After the loop/1 and loop/2 fixes, status still tells the agent evidence is refused where the guard accepts it. Repro (008e5eb3): a building subject t whose only change is an unapproved chore k, plus an untagged scenario; evidence add exits 0, yet its own next line and status say 'canon evidence add refuses ... t's untagged scenarios not evidenced before t adopted its first change, while no adopted change is approved'. With a tagged unapproved tg and a newer draft d, status prints both 'report the pending draft ... t is not blocked meanwhile' and tg's step saying t's untagged scenarios are refused. Fix: build the untagged clause from untagged_scope's answer (add it only when it waits on that change), and drop 'not blocked meanwhile' when another governing change blocks.
